einzeiler: Inside the new grassroots Kick 'n' Twist Chopper Show in Arkansas with Jason Ochoa and…
kurzfassung: The creators behind the upcoming Kick 'n' Twist Chopper Show discuss bringing a fresh, grassroots motorcycle event to northwest Arkansas. They break down the planning, venue details, and the community of builders coming together for the inaugural gathering. The conversation also covers memorable road trips, bike culture, and the spirit of grassroots events.
stichpunkte: Origins of the Kick 'n' Twist Chopper Show in Springdale, Arkansas
Partnering with Bikes, Blues and Barbecue to offer a custom bike alternative
Renting the 20-acre rodeo grounds of the Rodeo of the Ozarks for on-site camping and events
Securing top builders and featuring a mix of Midwest and Texas talent
Planning motorcycle games including slow races, kickstart contests, and mini bike events
Curating an indoor space for choppers, art, and photography with open layouts for easy viewing
Discussing the importance of grassroots events over corporate conventions
Reflecting on long-distance road trips, breakdowns, and camaraderie in motorcycle culture

kapitel.titel: Introduction and the Kick 'n' Twist Event
Road Trips, Sturgis, and Riding Stories

clips.hook: Renting out the whole rodeo grounds in Arkansas
clips.text: The event venue spans twenty acres and includes an arena, stadium, stables, camping fields, and food trucks.
Historical weather data shows daytime highs averaging around 75 degrees and night temperatures in the fifties and sixties.

clips.hook: Riding an iron butt straight from California
clips.text: The speaker completed a thousand-mile ride in a single day on the way back from California without any mechanical issues.

clips.hook: The real cost of booking bands for bike shows
clips.text: Renowned bands typically charge between fifteen hundred and thirty-five dollars to play a single set.

clips.hook: Hosting a major motorcycle show inside an old prison
clips.text: Holding a custom bike event at the historic Shawshank Redemption prison location creates an unmatched atmosphere.

beschreibung:
On today's episode, we're talking with Jason Ochoa from Four Speed Mayhem and Steve from Maniak Productions about the upcoming Kick and Twist event in Springdale, Arkansas, October 1st-4th, during the Bike Blue and BBQ event in northwest Arkansas. Choppers, Fxrs, and good times- hear all about it in today's episode!
